source_of_truth: Yandex publishes these sizes in its own requirements list, unlike the portals whose numbers only exist on a console form. The draft form still wins where the two disagree, and this file is corrected in the same commit that finds the disagreement.
confirmed_by_docs: icon and cover may not be screenshots from the game (5.6)
media carries no borders and no rounded corners (8.6)
media shows no system interface and no Yandex Games interface (8.7)
gameplay fills at least 70% of screenshots and of video duration (5.1)
the game name is identical in the game, the draft and the materials, and unique per language (5.2, 5.9)
repeated characters and duplicated text between fields are not allowed (5.8)
every archive keeps index.html at its root and ASCII file names (1.23)
all files together stay under 100 MB uncompressed (1.22)

assets.note: Square, no rounded corners, no border. Reads at 64 px in the catalogue grid.
Verify the ratio in the draft form before the first upload.
Real gameplay in the language of the card it sits under. The form: 16:9, long side 1280-2560, JPEG or 24-bit PNG without alpha.
Only when the draft declares mobile screenshots. The form states the rule: 9:16, long side 1280-2560, JPEG or 24-bit PNG without alpha.
Required by the draft form. Real gameplay filmed from the game, no mock overlays.
Optional in the form, but a mobile-declared game without it shows nothing to phone players.

texts.note: Identical to the name inside the game.
